Several words in the centre of the page (near "Ordinis illius", "Societas") are partly obscured by a stain and are transcribed on best reading. Line breaks reflect the printer's column; the scan is soft at the right edge of lines 4–6 and at the bottom lines, so "effectæ", "infusurrata", "dignemur" and "sincero" should be checked against the original. "Ordinis" and "Reformatione" are marked as read from the scan with partial certainty.
